decisions.decision: Treated MODE as 'new' for /gsd-ingest-docs despite init's planning_exists=true
decisions.rationale: planning_exists only reflects that .planning/codebase/ exists (from prior gsd-map-codebase run); project_exists/requirements_exists/roadmap_exists/state_exists are all false. The literal spec rule (planning_exists:true -> MODE=merge) would misroute into route_merge_mode, which expects an existing ROADMAP.md/PROJECT.md/REQUIREMENTS.md to load -- none exist. Used project_exists as the real signal instead.

decisions.rationale: User chose 'Re-run with --manifest' when asked how to handle the blockers. A true --manifest re-run would re-classify all 39 docs from scratch (expensive, ~15-20min). Since the cross_refs are confirmed navigational 'See also' links between parallel user guides (verified by reading all 7 JSONs), directly clearing the cyclic cross_refs entries achieves the same intent (breaking the cycle) without redoing classification.
